Let's connect, collaborate, and innovate
summary:
LunarBase – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive, browser-based educational simulation developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It allows users to explore simulated Moon and Mars missions, take the role of a mission commander, manage crew information, and monitor essential resources such as oxygen, water, food, and power.

The project addresses the challenge of making space exploration concepts more engaging and accessible through interactive learning. Features include mission setup, a mission control dashboard, resource alerts, crew condition monitoring, an activity log, progress saving, mission completion reports, animations, and sound effects.

LunarBase is important because it encourages curiosity about space exploration while developing problem-solving, planning, and technology skills. It is an independent student project, not an official NASA product.
details:
Project Details – LunarBase: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

LunarBase is an interactive, browser-based educational space mission simulator that introduces users to the concepts of Moon and Mars exploration. Users can select a destination, enter commander and crew details, launch a simulated mission, and manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, food, and power through a Mission Control dashboard.

The project includes mission-day progression, crew condition monitoring, resource alerts, an activity log, automatic progress saving, mission completion reports, animations, and electronic launch sound effects.

Benefits and Intended Impact:
LunarBase makes space exploration concepts more engaging and accessible, especially for students and beginners. It encourages curiosity, critical thinking, resource awareness, planning, and problem-solving through interactive learning.

Tools and Technologies:

  • HTML5 for webpage structure
  • CSS3 for styling, responsive design, and animations
  • JavaScript for mission logic and interactivity
  • LocalStorage for saving and restoring mission progress
  • Visual Studio Code for development
  • Web browsers for testing

Creativity and Innovation:
LunarBase transforms space mission planning into an interactive learning experience. Its combination of mission simulation, resource management, alerts, activity tracking, animations, and sound effects creates an engaging educational environment.

Factors Considered:
The project was designed with simplicity, accessibility, user-friendly navigation, responsive design, and educational value in mind. Resource levels are illustrative gameplay values rather than real NASA engineering calculations.

LunarBase is an independent student project developed by Inam Ullah under iWi Ternary Lab. It is not an official NASA product.
